name: snippy
description: Snippy monorepo - Angular frontend and Express backend.

scripts.generate:api: npm run dump:openapi --prefix snippy/backend && npm run generate:api --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.format:all: npm run format --prefix snippy/backend && npm run format --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.check:format: npm run format:check --prefix snippy/backend && npm run format:check --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.check:openapi: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- documentation/openapi.json snippy/frontend/src/app/api/openapi.json snippy/frontend/src/app/api/generated/
scripts.check:types: npm run typecheck --prefix snippy/backend && npm run typecheck --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.check:audit: npm audit --audit-level=high --prefix snippy/backend && npm audit --audit-level=high --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.check:build: npm run build --prefix snippy/backend && npm run build --prefix snippy/frontend -- --configuration production
scripts.check:all: npm run check:audit && npm run check:format && npm run check:types && npm run check:openapi && npm run check:build && npm run check:test
scripts.test:all: npm run test --prefix snippy/backend && npm run test --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.docker:compose:clear: docker compose down -v && docker compose build && docker compose up
scripts.docker:compose:up: docker compose build && docker compose up
